notes: needs ruling: «وَجَدْتُ بِخَطِّ سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ» cites a handwritten work by its author (as «في نوادر إبراهيم بن هاشم» does), so the first link is read from the cited author's hand, not a live transmitter
the Imam is the last link: the words after «أسنده إلى» are his (owner ruling 2)
